'''Benjamin Aaron Garcia'''<ref name=doctorate>{{cite book |url=https://majorevents.virginia.edu/sites/majorevents2017.virginia.edu/files/program_graduates05.pdf |title=One Hundred and Seventy-Sixth Final Exercises |date=May 22, 2005 |page=26 |publisher=University of Virginia |accessdate=2021-02-11 |archive-date=September 20, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210920212925/https://majorevents.virginia.edu/sites/majorevents2017.virginia.edu/files/program_graduates05.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref> (born May 19, 1976)<ref name=birth>{{cite book |title=Birth Index, 1905–1995 |publisher=State of California Department of Health Services, Center for Health |location=Sacramento, California}}</ref> is an American chemist and Professor at the [[Washington University School of Medicine]].<ref name="urlAbout The PI - Garcia Lab"/> His research interests revolve around developing novel [[mass spectrometry]] methods to analyze [[post-translational modifications]] of [[proteins]] and [[epigenetics]]. His work has resulted in over 250 publications and he has been recognized with numerous honors including the [[American Society for Mass Spectrometry]] [[Biemann Medal]] in 2018.

Raised in [[La Mirada, California]],<ref name=doctorate/> Garcia received his BS in [[Chemistry]] from [[University of California, Davis]] in 2000 and his PhD from the [[University of Virginia]] in 2005 where he worked with [[Donald F. Hunt|Donald Hunt]].<ref name="urlAbout The PI - Garcia Lab"/> His doctoral thesis was entitled ''Proteomic Applications of Tandem Mass Spectrometry''.<ref name=doctorate/> After postdoctoral work with [[Neil Kelleher (scientist)|Neil Kelleher]], he was appointed as an assistant professor at [[Princeton University]] where he worked until his appointment at the [[Perelman School of Medicine]] in 2012. In 2016, he was promoted to full Professor.<ref name="urlAbout The PI - Garcia Lab">{{cite web |url=http://hosting.med.upenn.edu/garcialab/about-the-pi/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151128082050/http://hosting.med.upenn.edu/garcialab/about-the-pi/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=November 28, 2015 |title=About The PI – Garcia Lab |format= |accessdate=2019-04-20}}</ref>
